server.otp.accountRecovery.subject: Your DokTool account recovery code
server.otp.accountRecovery.text: Your DokTool code to recover your account: {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes. Never share it: the DokTool team will never ask for it.
server.otp.contactChange.subject: Confirm your new DokTool contact
server.otp.contactChange.text: Your DokTool code to add this contact to your account: {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this message.
server.otp.passwordReset.subject: Reset your DokTool password
server.otp.passwordReset.text: Your DokTool reset code: {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this message.
server.otp.signUp.subject: Your DokTool confirmation code
server.otp.signUp.text: Your DokTool code: {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes. Do not share it with anyone.
server.security.contactAdded.subject: New contact on your DokTool account
server.security.contactAdded.text: Hello {firstName}, {channel, select, EMAIL {an e-mail address} other {a phone number}} was added to your DokTool account. It can be used to sign in and to recover your account. If this was not you, change your password.
server.security.contactRemoved.subject: Contact removed from your DokTool account
server.security.contactRemoved.text: Hello {firstName}, the {channel, select, EMAIL {e-mail address} other {phone number}} was removed from your DokTool account. If this was not you, change your password.
server.security.contactReplaced.subject: Contact changed on your DokTool account
server.security.contactReplaced.text: Hello {firstName}, the {channel, select, EMAIL {e-mail address} other {phone number}} of your DokTool account was just replaced. This message also goes to the previous contact. If this was not you, contact DokTool support.
server.security.passwordChanged.subject: Your DokTool password was changed
server.security.passwordChanged.text: Hello {firstName}, the password of your DokTool account was just changed and your other devices were signed out. If this was not you, tap “Forgot password” in the app right away.
server.security.passwordReset.subject: Your DokTool password was reset
server.security.passwordReset.text: Hello {firstName}, the password of your DokTool account was just reset and all your devices were signed out. If this was not you, tap “Forgot password” in the app right away.
server.security.recoveryAccepted.subject: Recovery request accepted
server.security.recoveryAccepted.text: Your DokTool account recovery request is accepted. For your security, it takes effect on {date}. You will then get a message to choose a new password.
server.security.recoveryApplied.subject: The contacts of your DokTool account were replaced
server.security.recoveryApplied.text: The contacts of your DokTool account were replaced after a recovery request checked by our team. This address or number is no longer linked to the account. If this was not you, contact DokTool support.
server.security.recoveryApproved.subject: DokTool account recovery accepted
server.security.recoveryApproved.text: Hello {firstName}, a request to recover your DokTool account was accepted. It takes effect on {date}. If this was not you, sign in with your password before then: it will be cancelled.
server.security.recoveryCanceled.subject: Recovery request cancelled
server.security.recoveryCanceled.text: Your DokTool account recovery request was cancelled: the account holder signed in, or the contact you gave is already used by another account. If this is a mistake, make a new request from the app.
server.security.recoveryReceived.subject: Recovery request received
server.security.recoveryReceived.text: We received your DokTool account recovery request. The team will answer here within {hours} hours. If you find your password meanwhile, just sign in: the request will be cancelled.
server.security.recoveryRejected.subject: Recovery request not accepted
server.security.recoveryRejected.text: Your DokTool account recovery request could not be accepted: {reason, select, PHOTO_UNREADABLE {the photos are not readable} IDENTITY_MISMATCH {the identity document does not match the account} SELFIE_MISMATCH {the selfie does not confirm your identity} NO_ACCOUNT {no account matches the contact you gave} other {the information does not confirm your identity}}. You can make a new request from the app.
server.security.recoveryRequested.subjec: Recovery request for your DokTool account
server.security.recoveryRequested.text: Hello {firstName}, someone asked to recover your DokTool account with a new contact. If it was you, there is nothing to do. Otherwise, sign in with your password, or tap “This wasn’t me” in Settings › Account: the request will be cancelled.
server.security.recoveryRestored.subject: Your DokTool account is recovered
server.security.recoveryRestored.text: Your DokTool account is recovered: {contact} is now its only contact. Open the app, tap “Forgot password” and enter {contact} to choose a new password. Then add a second contact in Settings › Account.
